settings.heading: Buy land, no bank required
settings.text: Most of our parcels are available with simple owner financing. Put a down payment on the land you want and pay the rest in fixed monthly installments — no credit check and no prepayment penalty.

settings.title: Put money down
settings.text: Reserve with a down payment at checkout.

settings.title: Pay monthly
settings.text: Fixed installments, no credit check, no penalty for paying early.

settings.title: Get your deed
settings.text: Once paid in full, the deed is recorded in your name.

settings.question: Is there a credit check?
settings.answer: No. Owner financing does not require a credit check.

settings.question: Can I pay off early?
settings.answer: Yes — there is no prepayment penalty. Pay off your balance whenever you like.

settings.question: When do I get the deed?
settings.answer: The deed is recorded in your name once the parcel is paid in full.

settings.heading: Start with a down payment
settings.subtext: Find a parcel that fits your budget and reserve it today.
